assumptions: All throughput ranges are planning scenarios, not measured or source-reported results.
Throughput means completed optimizer-training tokens per elapsed second, including forward, backward, optimizer and normal data loading.
The 30 percent reserve is for evaluation, reruns, compilation and debugging; it is not a statistical confidence bound.
Conversion and warmup tokens are inside each run budget and must never be omitted from accounting.
Tax, currency conversion, paid model APIs and unplanned architecture changes are excluded.
Replica stages are incremental costs. Multiple GPUs only shorten elapsed time if measured scaling allows; GPU hours do not divide by card count.
A slower-than-assumed implementation requires a revised estimate before a long run.
Stage budgets are proposed estimates, not user-approved spending limits. No Pod is created by these files.
